By the time I arrived, she had cooked mu, had been cooking mi? İkisi de geçmişteki bir andan önceyi anlatır; ama biri sonucu, diğeri süreci vurgular. Videoda iki kuralı ve iki tuzağı adım adım gör.

Şu cümlede boşluğa ne gelir: "When we finally met, he ___ (wait) for two hours." Yoruma yaz.

sahneler.baslik: Had Done or Had Been Doing?
sahneler.ses: Had done, or had been doing? Here is the difference.

sahneler.once: She wrote the report, then she left.
sahneler.sonra: She had written the report before she left.
sahneler.not: had + V3: Geçmişteki bir olaydan önce bitmiş iş.

sahneler.once: He was tired. He ran for an hour.
sahneler.sonra: He was tired because he had been running for an hour.
sahneler.not: had been + V-ing: Önceki ana kadar süren eylem; süre önemli (for, since).

sahneler.once: I had been reading three books by Monday.
sahneler.sonra: I had read three books by Monday.
sahneler.not: Kaç tane bittiği söyleniyorsa sürekli değil, had + V3 kullanılır.

sahneler.once: I had been knowing him for years.
sahneler.sonra: I had known him for years.
sahneler.not: know, believe, own gibi durum fiilleri -ing almaz: had known.

satirlar: had V3: bitmiş iş, sonuç önemli
had been V-ing: süreç, süre önemli
sahneler.ses: Finished result: had done. Ongoing process: had been doing. With a number or a state verb, use had done.
Which one would you use? Tell us in the comments.

reels.aciklama:
"Do a mistake" mı, "make a mistake" mı? YDT ve YDS'deki kelime sorularında bu kalıplar sık sık karşına çıkar. Videoda en sık yapılan üç hatayı düzelttik, sonra make, do, take ve have kalıplarını bir arada verdik.

Sen hangisini yanlış kullanıyordun? Yoruma yaz.

sahneler.ses: Make, do, or take? Three mistakes you should stop making.

sahneler.once: I did a mistake in the exam.
sahneler.sonra: I made a mistake in the exam.
sahneler.not: make a mistake: hata yapmak (do değil).
do research: araştırma yapmak. Daha akademik: conduct research.

sahneler.once: We made precautions against the flood.
sahneler.sonra: We took precautions against the flood.

satirlar: make: a mistake, an effort, a decision
have: a look, a rest, a word
sahneler.ses: Make a mistake. Do research. Take precautions. Have a look.
Which one did you mix up? Tell us in the comments.
